## Web search (allow-listed)
Called by the chat agent as **search_web** when a question asks about *current* regulations, recent changes or best practices, or the documents don't answer it.

One call to the Azure OpenAI **Responses API** with its built-in **web_search** tool, restricted to an **allow-list of authoritative domains** (by default federal: EPA, eCFR, Federal Register, FHWA, NRCS, USACE, FEMA, NOAA/USGS — plus any state or local domains you add). Returns findings + source links + today's date so the agent can label them **"From the web"**, separate from **"From your documents"**.

Privacy: only a short model-written search query leaves Azure (to the web search provider); the agent is instructed never to put document text, file names, project names or people in a query.
